data.name: Why
data.value: The app starts like a normal app from your home screen – without an address bar and with shortcuts for appointments, mailbox and reports. For data protection it does not store pages with your personal data on the device.

data.name: Ios_Step2
data.value: Choose “Add to Home Screen” (scroll down the list if needed)

data.name: Ios_Step3
data.value: Confirm with “Add” – BürgerPortal appears on your home screen.

data.name: Ios_Note
data.value: Other browsers on the iPhone (e.g. Chrome, Edge) also offer “Add to Home Screen” in the share menu if they support it.

data.name: Android_Step2
data.value: Choose “Install app” or “Add to home screen” and confirm.

data.name: AndroidFirefox_Step2
data.value: Choose “Install” or “Add to home screen” and confirm.

data.name: Desktop_Step1
data.value: Click the “Install app” icon on the right of the address bar

data.name: Desktop_Step2
data.value: Or choose “Install BürgerPortal” in the browser menu under “Apps” or “Save and share”.

data.name: Firefox_Text
data.value: Firefox does not offer installing web apps on the computer, or only to a limited extent depending on the version. Open the portal in Edge or Chrome – or on your phone.

data.name: SafariMac_Text
data.value: In Safari on macOS Sonoma or later, choose “Add to Dock” in the “File” menu.
